THE STOCK ADJUSTMENT ACCOUNT IS OPERATED TO FOR RECORDING DIFFERENCES ARISING OUT OF :- i) Variation in stock noticed on account of Stock Verification or Departmental Stock Verification. ii)Changes in Price of stock purchased from market or manufactured at workshop. iii)Difference in book value and actual value realised on Scrap sale iv)Rounding off

options.B: only I , ii and iii are correct

It is the clearing account for all stock value differences.
